analysis.causal-capture: Every variant causal capture state differs from the projected acquired state by <1e-6 in relative quadratic energy. This excludes omitted exterior energy, which is reported separately.
analysis.causal-timing: For all three spectra each finest causal first/last timing residual is <=1e-4 and the separate residual budget B (mesh residual change + time residual change + domain residual change + surface/output sampling +1e-7) is <=1e-4; require residual <=B. Missing markers or B>target is unresolved, resolved violation fails.
analysis.continuum-events: For both methods and source reference, each finest absolute event mesh change is <=0.6 preceding change plus time/domain/sampling differences and 1e-7; otherwise unresolved. No absolute continuum timing accuracy is implied.
analysis.decomposition: Every source-minus-inverse local history equals the separately propagated retained plus discarded input error to relative 1e-8, with absolute floor 1e-10.
analysis.inverse-observability: Each finest event conditional first-order timing bound is <=1e-4 and no admissible finite singular-direction witness exceeds 1e-4. A witness beyond target rejects robustness; a bound above target without witness is unresolved.
analysis.prediction-first: Each variant locks both reconstruction forecasts and sensitivities before its known-source interior audit; every frozen input and forecast hash verifies.
analysis.sampling: Each finest event changes <=1e-4 under output decimation .0125 to .025; causal surface sampling .0125 to .025 is separately <=1e-4. Otherwise unresolved.
analysis.source-energy: Frozen unforced acquisition conserves its quadratic neutral energy to relative 1e-6 over t=0..16 on every grid and waveform. No clock radiation is inferred.
analysis.surface-replay: All synthetic single-site inverse replay residuals are below 1e-7. This check alone does not establish interior observability.
